newsitem.title: SYRIA: Radicals say attacks on Israel settlers to go on.
newsitem.headline: Radicals say attacks on Israel settlers to go on.

text.p: A radical Palestinian guerrilla group on Thursday refused to confirm or deny responsibility for the killing of a Jewish settler and her son in the West Bank but said attacks on settlers would go on.
Arab gunmen shot dead a 12-year-old Israeli boy and his mother in a drive-by shooting near the PLO-ruled West Bank town of Ramallah on Wednesday.
Maher al-Taher, a spokesman for the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine (PFLP), accused by Israel of carrying out the killings, said Palestinians were duty-bound to attack Jewish settlers.

"We do not deny or confirm the Ramallah operation, but we remind that the front had several times warned that settlements and settlers would be military targets that Palestinians have right and duty to attack."
"The Palestinian people have no choice but to confront settlements and occupation with all means," he said.

Taher said Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's encouragement for settlements showed that he refused to withdraw from occupied Palestinian lands in defiance of the Arab and international communities.
He said military operations by the PFLP, which has big influence in the West Bank, would continue against Israel.
"Resistance has not ceased and will never cease until we achieve our people's rights for self-determination and establishment of an indepedent Palestinian state with Jerusalem as its capital."
The PFLP is part of a 10-member Palestinian alliance based in Damascus which is opposed to the peace deal between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organisation.
